title: Working Fundamentals of Astrophysics
summary: A practical, calculation-driven 4-week introduction to astrophysics. Master orbital mechanics, radiation laws, stellar interiors, compact remnants, and cosmological expansion using core physical equations and real observational data.

days.title: Keplerian Orbits and Planetary Motion
objectives: Calculate semi-major axes and orbital periods using Kepler's third law
Compute orbital velocity at periastron and apastron for eccentric orbits

days.title: Gravitational Potential and Escape Velocity
objectives: Calculate the escape velocity for any spherical celestial body
Determine whether a test mass is gravitationally bound given its kinetic and potential energy

days.title: Radiation Flux and Luminosity
objectives: Calculate radiant flux from a source using the inverse-square law
Differentiate between intrinsic luminosity and observed flux in astronomical measurements

days.title: Blackbody Radiation and Stellar Temperatures
objectives: Determine a star's surface temperature using Wien's displacement law
Estimate total stellar luminosity using the Stefan-Boltzmann law and stellar radius

days.title: Astronomical Spectroscopy and Radial Velocity
objectives: Identify primary stellar absorption lines across spectral types
Calculate line-of-sight velocity using the non-relativistic Doppler shift equation

weeks.theme: Stellar Properties, Interiors, and Energy Generation

days.title: Astronomical Distances and Magnitude Systems
objectives: Convert between stellar parallax angles in arcseconds and distance in parsecs
Calculate absolute magnitude and distance modulus from apparent magnitude

days.title: The Hertzsprung-Russell Diagram and Stellar Classification
objectives: Place stars on the HR diagram using spectral type and absolute magnitude
Extract stellar radius trends from an HR diagram plot

days.title: Hydrostatic Equilibrium and Core Pressures
objectives: Formulate the hydrostatic balance equation for a stable spherical star
Estimate central pressure and core temperature using dimensional scaling

days.title: Nuclear Fusion and Stellar Energy Production
objectives: Trace the proton-proton chain and CNO cycle energy release mechanisms
Calculate mass defect and energy release per fusion reaction using E=mc^2

days.title: Mass-Luminosity Relation and Stellar Lifetimes
objectives: Estimate main-sequence luminosity from stellar mass using power-law scaling
Compute the main-sequence lifetime of a star relative to the Sun

days.title: Post-Main-Sequence Evolution and Giant Phases
objectives: Chart the post-main-sequence track of a 1-solar-mass star on the HR diagram
Explain physical triggers behind core helium flashes and planetary nebula ejection

days.title: White Dwarfs and Degeneracy Pressure
objectives: Calculate white dwarf radius using electron degeneracy scaling
Determine the Chandrasekhar mass limit and describe the conditions under which it fails

days.title: Supernovae and Neutron Stars
objectives: Distinguish between Type Ia and core-collapse supernova mechanisms
Calculate the average density and surface gravity of a 1.4-solar-mass neutron star

days.title: Black Holes and the Schwarzschild Metric
objectives: Calculate the Schwarzschild radius for stellar and supermassive black holes
Compute gravitational redshift for photons emitted near an event horizon

days.title: Binary Systems and Mass Transfer
objectives: Identify Roche lobe overflow conditions in close binary systems
Calculate binary orbital separation from orbital period and component masses

weeks.theme: Galactic Dynamics, High-Energy Astrophysics, and Cosmology

days.title: Galactic Rotation and Dark Matter
objectives: Plot expected Keplerian versus observed flat galactic rotation curves
Calculate the dynamical mass enclosed within a given galactic radius

days.title: Active Galactic Nuclei and the Eddington Limit
objectives: Calculate the theoretical maximum luminosity (Eddington limit) for an accretion disk
Estimate black hole accretion rate from observed bolometric AGN luminosity

days.title: Cosmic Expansion and Hubble's Law
objectives: Calculate recessional velocity and distance using Hubble's law
Estimate the age of the universe from Hubble constant measurements

days.title: Cosmological Redshift and Scale Factor
objectives: Convert between cosmological redshift z and cosmic scale factor a(t)
Calculate lookback time and distance for low-redshift astronomical targets

days.title: The Cosmic Microwave Background and Energy Budget
objectives: Interpret the Planck spectrum and peak temperature of the CMB
Calculate critical density and evaluate the cosmic energy breakdown between matter and dark energy
